Primary text and dark backgrounds\r\n- Light: `#faf9f5` - Light backgrounds and text on dark\r\n- Mid Gray: `#b0aea5` - Secondary elements\r\n- Light Gray: `#e8e6dc` - Subtle backgrounds\r\n\r\n**Accent Colors:**\r\n\r\n- Orange: `#d97757` - works with existing system fonts\r\n- For best results, pre-install Poppins and Lora fonts in your environment\r\n\r\n### Color Application\r\n\r\n- Uses RGB color values for precise brand matching\r\n- Applied via python-pptx's RGBColor class\r\n- Maintains color fidelity across different systems"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"84137f2d-b253-4a7a-ba29-d1a30e95edee","uuid":"7f29da92-2313-401c-9b2c-b7dbf11d0b5d","timestamp":"2026-03-19T22:59:36.577Z","isSynthetic":true}
